systems.rag: Generic GPT plus the same retrieved cases the twin saw
systems.twin: Doctor's Twin. Retrieval, the eval graph, and the style rules exclude the held-out cases.
systems.baseline: Fixed plan on every case: ECG, echo, and a lipid panel. No model call.

gold.tests: Test names found in the recorded tests column and the recorded treatment decision.
gold.not_scored: Risk level and follow-up interval are not scored. The answers do not state them apart from a fixed safety line.

excluded.retrieval: These case ids are passed to retrieval as exclude_ids before Generic GPT with cases, and before the Doctor's Twin, answers.
excluded.rule: graph_nodes.csv and graph_edges.csv have no case id column. A node is removed when its name appears in a held-out case and in no training case. An edge is removed when either end was removed, or the two names occur together only in a held-out case. A style rule is removed when it names a held-out case. Nodes that never appear in a case are kept, because they are not held-out case content.

label_audit.reason: Risk agreement and follow-up agreement were the same 0.23 for every system because the extractor labeled the answer urgent and immediate whenever those words appeared. Generic GPT and GPT with retrieved cases always include the fixed line “Escalate immediately if chest pain worsens, rest pain appears, or dyspnea increases.” The twin prompt also tells the model to mention urgent care. Those words are a safety line, not the risk level of the plan and not the follow-up interval. The two columns are not scored.
